title: Painters, Construction and Maintenance
description: Paint walls, equipment, buildings, bridges, and other structural surfaces, using brushes, rollers, and spray guns. May remove old paint to prepare surface prior to painting. May mix colors or oils to obtain desired color or consistency.

tasks.text: Cover surfaces with dropcloths or masking tape and paper to protect surfaces during painting.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on placement of protective coverings

dwas.name: Protect structures or surfaces near work areas to avoid damage.

tasks.text: Read work orders or receive instructions from supervisors or homeowners to determine work requirements.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Specs reading aided, human validates requirements

dwas.name: Review blueprints or specifications to determine work requirements.

tasks.text: Apply paint, stain, varnish, enamel, or other finishes to equipment, buildings, bridges, or other structures, using brushes, spray guns, or rollers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying paint requires physical brush or spray work

dwas.name: Apply paint to surfaces.

tasks.text: Fill cracks, holes, or joints with caulk, putty, plaster, or other fillers, using caulking guns or putty knives.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying filler to surfaces is hands-on

dwas.name: Apply material to fill gaps in surfaces.

tasks.text: Smooth surfaces, using sandpaper, scrapers, brushes, steel wool, or sanding machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Abrasive hand work on physical surfaces

dwas.name: Smooth surfaces with abrasive materials or tools.

tasks.text: Erect scaffolding or swing gates, or set up ladders, to work above ground level.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Erecting temporary structures requires physical assembly

dwas.name: Assemble temporary equipment or structures.

tasks.text: Wash and treat surfaces with oil, turpentine, mildew remover, or other preparations, and sand rough spots to ensure that finishes will adhere properly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.
Prepare surfaces for finishing.

tasks.text: Apply primers or sealers to prepare new surfaces, such as bare wood or metal, for finish coats.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on surface preparation before finishing

dwas.name: Prepare surfaces for finishing.

tasks.text: Calculate amounts of required materials and estimate costs, based on surface measurements or work orders.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Material takeoffs from plans; human verifies quantities

dwas.name: Estimate construction project costs.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Estimate materials requirements for projects.

tasks.text: Remove old finishes by stripping, sanding, wire brushing, burning, or using water or abrasive blasting.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.

tasks.text: Remove fixtures such as pictures, door knobs, lamps, or electric switch covers prior to painting.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on placement of protective coverings

dwas.name: Protect structures or surfaces near work areas to avoid damage.

tasks.text: Use special finishing techniques such as sponging, ragging, layering, or faux finishing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on textured finish application

dwas.name: Apply decorative or textured finishes or coverings.

tasks.text: Waterproof buildings, using waterproofers or caulking.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying sealants requires hands-on coating

dwas.name: Apply sealants or other protective coatings.

tasks.text: Select and purchase tools or finishes for surfaces to be covered, considering durability, ease of handling, methods of application, and customers' wishes.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Construction procurement needs human supplier judgment

dwas.name: Select construction equipment.
Order construction or extraction materials or equipment.

tasks.text: Mix and match colors of paint, stain, or varnish with oil or thinning and drying additives to obtain desired colors and consistencies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.

tasks.text: Polish final coats to specified finishes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Abrasive hand work on physical surfaces

dwas.name: Smooth surfaces with abrasive materials or tools.

tasks.text: Cut stencils and brush or spray lettering or decorations on surfaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand cutting of flexible flooring materials

dwas.name: Cut carpet, vinyl or other flexible materials.
Apply decorative or textured finishes or coverings.

emerging_tasks.task: Clean tools and equipment, such as brushes and rollers.
